A '''Great Hunt''' was held by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] prior to the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] known as [[Bloodworthy]] emerged victorious in the [[Great Hunt (competition)|competition]].
